title: Quang Noodle Soup
description: A popular Vietnamese noodle soup made with a rich pork broth, Quang noodles, and various toppings.
instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the Quang noodles according to the package instructions.
2. In a separate pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
3. Add the diced onion and sliced ginger and cook until the onion is translucent.
4. Add the pork bones and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add 4 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for at least 1 hour, or overnight for a richer broth.
7. Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot and discard the solids.
8. Add the fish sauce, soy sauce, and chilli flakes (if using) to the broth and stir to combine.
9. Cook the Quang noodles according to the package instructions and divide among bowls.
10. Ladle the hot broth over the noodles and garnish with bean sprouts, fresh herbs, and a sprinkle of chilli flakes (if using).
